unresolved_limitations: Exact sampling distribution of the pooled AP difference under a valid relation-randomisation null is unknown (needs the corrected-G2 artifact).

The estimand is a pooled triplicated-row AP over 3 overlapping windows; its interpretation as an out-of-sample ranking metric is design-dependent, and no window-level generalisation is identified with only 3 windows.

Bootstrap coverage for the pair-clustered unit with dependent pairs (same company) and triplicated rows is assessed only by simulation of the observed configuration, not by a known-truth generative model.

Rule-level power uses a multivariate-normal location-shift approximation; alternative constructions with different variance structures can move the rule MDE, so it is a defensible order-of-magnitude statement (~0.04 AP), not an exact design guarantee.

warnings: PRE_REGISTRATION section 11 criterion (c) requires point estimate >= MDE for SUPPORT. This is a power-dependent criterion: a real effect smaller than the study's MDE could never support H1 even if its CI excluded 0. It is applied literally here but should not be read as a scientific decision rule in a future round.
